==Bundles==
Slate is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Slate is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Slate is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt086|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a gray dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Slate is not used in any [[quests]].
